### `pilecap.attach.TAG_ARCHIVED`

A word left the vocabulary. Payload: `schemas.DjbTagOut`, `archived_at` set. Its links stay on their subjects; a subscriber may not conclude they went.

- value · source `apps/djb_tags/events.py:16`

### `pilecap.attach.TAG_CREATED`

A word was coined. Payload: `schemas.DjbTagOut`.

- value · source `apps/djb_tags/events.py:9`

### `pilecap.attach.TAG_LINK_CREATED`

A subject now carries a tag. Payload: `schemas.DjbTagLinkOut`. A repeated request for a link that already exists says nothing — nothing happened.

- value · source `apps/djb_tags/events.py:23`

### `pilecap.attach.TAG_LINK_DELETED`

A subject no longer carries a tag. Payload: `schemas.DjbTagLinkOut` of the row that went, id included, so a subscriber can match it.

- value · source `apps/djb_tags/events.py:27`

### `pilecap.attach.TAG_LINK_MOVED`

A link followed a merged subject to its survivor. Payload: `schemas.DjbTagLinkOut` as the link now reads — the survivor's pointer and branch. A loser's link the survivor already carried is deleted instead, and says `djb_tags.tag_link.deleted`.

- value · source `apps/djb_tags/events.py:33`

### `pilecap.attach.TAG_RENAMED`

A word was respelled. Payload: `schemas.DjbTagOut`, with the new name and slug.

- value · source `apps/djb_tags/events.py:12`

### `pilecap.attach.TAG_RESTORED`

A word came back. Payload: `schemas.DjbTagOut`, `archived_at` cleared.

- value · source `apps/djb_tags/events.py:19`
